significance: A riverside Shakti shrine on the bank of the Mahanadi at Sasanga in Baramba, Cuttack district, where the goddess Bhattarika is worshipped as a manifestation of Durga. Durga Puja is its principal annual observance.
story: Puranic tradition says the goddess appeared at this spot to lend Parashurama her power when he faced defeat at the hands of Sahasrarjuna.
